rules.sentence: Pott puffy tumor (PPT) is a subperiosteal abscess of the forehead associated with underlying frontal bone osteomyelitis.
PPT can also be caused by ethmoid sinusitis, forehead trauma, allergic rhinitis, insect bites, acupuncture, malignancy, and various other conditions.

Prompt identification of PPT is essential for maximizing recovery chances, as delays in treatment can lead to serious intracranial complications, including epidural abscess, subdural abscess, and dural venous sinus thrombosis.
Diagnosis is confirmed through imaging, and treatment usually involves long-term parenteral antibiotics, often combined with surgery.
